description: Land Title Settlement Department - Idibedda, Moratuwa D/S/Division Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520203 (24/55026)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land ownership, property transfers, and title registration processes under the Registration of Title Act.
